subject: Media Literacy
title: The Future of Media Ethics
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Future of Media Ethics usable.

hook.text: AI can now write news articles, generate fake interviews, and create synthetic video. The ethics rulebook has no chapter for this.

buildup.text: Emerging technologies — AI content generation, deepfakes, synthetic media — challenge every existing ethical framework.

discovery.text: New ethical questions include: who is responsible for AI-generated misinformation? Can algorithms have editorial ethics?

twist.text: Technology moves faster than ethics. By the time we establish norms for deepfakes, the next challenge will already exist.

climax.text: The core principles remain: truth, minimizing harm, accountability. How we apply them must constantly evolve.

punchline.text: The tools change. The questions stay the same. Is it true? Does it help?

quiz.question: What challenge does AI pose to media ethics?
options: New technologies create ethical questions faster than frameworks can address them
